title: spermacoce ovalis
intro: Spermacoce ovalis, commonly known as "Small White Spermacoce" or "Button Weed", is a perennial herbaceous plant in the Rubiaceae family, often found in moist areas and grasslands. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce ovalis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antifungal, antibacterial, and anti-cancer activities. Furthermore, the plant's extracts have been found to possess immunomodulatory, hepatoprotective, and nephroprotective effects, making it a potential candidate for the development of novel pharmaceuticals and therapeutic agents.
